summary: HSBC Holdings plc filed a Form 6-K on 25 August 2026, notifying transactions by PDMRs involving allotment of dividend equivalents under the HSBC Share Plan 2011. On 21 August 2026, shares were awarded to nine executives at a price of £15.1928 per share, being the average closing price over five business days from 13 August 2026. Transactions are routine compensation-related allotments under UK MAR. The filing is a standard foreign private issuer report, not a special situation, and no deal terms apply.
